boundaries.source: Relative to exact source-fix head 8a467ef5ad72fac87561dc74f1818f3b9c3037bc, changes are confined to the two named cfg(test) functions, one hostile-parser test function and this manifest. All bytes outside those function regions, including production implementation and unrelated tests, are byte-identical. The original eight protected files remain byte-identical. No main sync, new hook, workflow, dependency, budget, generated pin, configuration or documentation change.
boundaries.externalServices: No database, live Discord, staging or production mutation during authoring. Database-backed cases require the repository-guarded disposable TestDatabase service; HTTP effects use existing local doubles.
boundaries.runtime: Real parsing, role/access gates, actor command dispatch, service/transaction/import/replay paths and response rendering; command-only actors exclude unrelated timer maintenance.
boundaries.readOnly: Current owner versus original creator, one ephemeral reply, poisoned room-store reads, durable and runtime room/privacy snapshots, queue, create claims, overwrite writes and effect traces remain pinned.

contract.cap: Recorded UserCap and the four non-cap operator diagnostics remain byte-identical and context-free, with or without known owned rooms. No member-specific room IDs enter diagnostic dedup keys or notices.
contract.privacy: Observed known @everyone Connect ACL determines the listed state. An accepted Connect-open overwrite followed by refused Join deletion must list public while persisted private=true and retry bookkeeping remain unchanged. Unknown overwrites yield unavailable, not public; explicitly empty overwrites remain known public evidence.
contract.singleSnapshot: Ready, presence and ACL facts must come from one live read guard. The deterministic test covers queued-read disconnect/reconnect ordering and new-generation ACL results; it does not reproduce an intrafunction interleaving between synchronous guard acquisitions.
contract.configImport: Reject myroom command_roles entries in codec/import, preview and Confirm, including empty role lists, until that distinct policy store can enforce them. Runtime /access restrict and the runtime allowlist continue to support myroom.
contract.rollback: Before reverting to the prior strict reader, use /access show and /access unrestrict command:myroom in every affected guild and read back the runtime store. Cleanup removes only myroom; unrelated established restrictions remain old-reader compatible. Config export/import is not runtime-store clearance evidence.
contract.capacity: 33 noncolliding custom rows remain exportable/importable and manageable without growth. Voice off/on publication remains 45+33=78 and 67+33=100. Held assistant metadata reserves its name, not another publication slot. 34-row genuine overflow is refused with no partial transaction writes; internal import and replay use the same bound.
contract.legacyCustom: With automations on and voice off, saved pre-upgrade custom myroom continues to publish, dispatch, edit and pause/resume. With voice on, the voice slash handler wins. Fresh names remain safe and other saved customs remain usable.
contract.responseBound: 61 private rooms with 19-digit IDs produce a completion input of at most 2000 scalars with complete rows and explicit omitted-room accounting, or an inspectable bounded complete UTF-8 room-list attachment. Exactly one private response and no room mutations remain required.
